name: vivideo-prompt-builder
description:
Vivideo AI Video Prompt Generator turns a rough idea into a detailed, production-ready prompt for any AI video generator.
Describe the AI video you want to create, and Vivideo structures your concept into subject, action, setting, camera, lighting, visual style, mood, composition, motion, aspect ratio and duration. It also creates a negative prompt designed to reduce common artifacts in AI-generated videos.
Browse 29 curated styles for cinematic AI video, product videos, social clips, talking-head videos, animation, travel, food, fashion, real estate and image-to-video motion. Apply a style using its stable ID, then customize any individual field.
Use Vivideo with a text-to-video AI or image-to-video AI workflow to prepare prompts for an online AI video generator, AI video maker, AI video creator, AI animation generator, AI clip generator, AI short video generator or AI marketing video generator. Copy the finished prompt into your preferred tool to generate an AI video from text or an image.
The connector is free to use, requires no account or authentication, and does not store your prompts.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Builds structured text prompts for AI video systems. Call list_video_prompt_styles to see the available styles and their ids, then call build_video_prompt with the concept and an optional style_id. This server returns text only: it does not generate video, images, or audio, does not access any account, and stores nothing.

tool.name: build_video_prompt
tool.title: Build an AI video prompt
tool.description: Converts a video concept and optional production choices into a structured, model-agnostic text prompt for an AI video system. Returns prompt text, a negative prompt, and normalized generation settings. It generates text only; it does not create media, access accounts, or save data.

idea.description: The video concept in a sentence or two. Name the subject, what it does, and where.

avoid.description: Things to exclude, added to the standard negative prompt. Plain terms such as "brand logos".

action.description: The single main thing happening. One clear action works best.

camera.description: Shot size and camera movement, for example "low tracking shot".

setting.description: Location plus time of day or weather.

subject.description: Who or what is on screen, if the idea should be sharpened.

lighting.description: Light source and quality, for example "neon reflections on wet streets".

style_id.description: Optional style id from list_video_prompt_styles. Supplies camera, lighting, visual style and mood defaults. An unrecognized id is ignored and noted in the result.

composition.description: Explicit framing instruction, overriding the aspect-ratio default.

destination.description: Where the clip will be published. Affects composition and aspect ratio only. Defaults to general.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame shape. Defaults to 9:16 for tiktok, instagram_reels and youtube_shorts, otherwise 16:9.

visual_style.description: Medium, look and grade, for example "cinematic 35mm".

generation_mode.description: text_to_video builds a scene from nothing; image_to_video animates an existing image and preserves its subject. Defaults to text_to_video.

motion_strength.description: How much movement to ask for. Defaults to balanced, or subtle for image_to_video.

duration_seconds.description: Intended clip length in whole seconds. Defaults to 8.

notes.description: Assumptions the compiler made, in plain language. Empty when nothing was assumed.

prompt.description: The positive prompt, ready to paste into a video model.

settings.description: Normalized generation settings to use alongside the prompt.

structure.description: The prompt broken into its parts, showing what was supplied and what was defaulted.

_published_faq.name: How do I add vivideo-prompt-builder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add vivideo-prompt-builder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://prompts.vivideo.ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is vivideo-prompt-builder MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, vivideo-prompt-builder scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is vivideo-prompt-builder's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, vivideo-prompt-builder scores 92/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 2 of 2 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the vivideo-prompt-builder MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: vivideo-prompt-builder provides these MCP tools: build_video_prompt and list_video_prompt_styles.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to vivideo-prompt-builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to vivideo-prompt-builder in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, gpt-war, and Atelier.
vivideo-prompt-builder does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
vivideo-prompt-builder is developed by Vivideo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
